blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate T-staging is crucial for guiding personalized treatment strategies for laryngopharyngeal cancer. However, current clinical practice relies on invasive biopsy procedures, whereas CT-based staging remains challenging due to the complex patterns of tumor invasion. Recent computer-aided approaches face two key challenges: 1) Structural relationship modeling: existing methods underrepresent anatomically structured patterns of tumor invasion, as they either process whole CT volumes without tumor-specific anatomical constraints or rely on labor-intensive tumor segmentation. 2) Fine-grained cross-modal alignment: while radiology reports contain organ-specific invasion details, current methods that apply global feature fusion struggle to accurately align individual anatomical structures with their corresponding textual descriptions. To address these issues, we propose an anatomy-aware multimodal framework that integrates organ-level CT context and radiology reports into a unified representation for laryngopharyngeal T-staging. The framework first constructs an Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph (AOG) that captures invasion patterns between primary sites and surrounding organs, then performs Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment (OCA) so that each organ node aggregates textual evidence from the radiology report, and finally refines this graph representation by injecting organ-specific invasion cues extracted from the report via Report-Enhanced Graph-Refinement (REG) , yielding a multimodal organ graph that combines spatial and textual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves superior performance in T-staging of laryngopharyngeal cancer.
blocks.zh: 准确的T-Stage对于指导喉癌的个性化治疗战略至关重要。 然而,目前的临床实践依赖于入侵性活体检查程序,而基于CT的培养因肿瘤入侵的复杂模式而仍然具有挑战性。 最近计算机辅助方法面临两个关键挑战: 1)结构关系模型化:现有方法在解剖学上代表了肿瘤入侵的结构规律,因为它们要么处理整个CT卷而无肿瘤特定的解剖约束,要么依赖于劳动密集型肿瘤分化. 2)精细的跨模式对接:虽然放射学报告包含有器官特有入侵细节,但当前应用全球特征聚变斗争的方法将个别解剖结构精确地与相应的文字描述相配合. 为了解决这些问题,我们提议建立一个解剖意识多模式框架,将器官一级的CT上下文和放射学报告纳入Layngopharyeal T-staging的统一代表。 该框架首先构筑出一个解剖学 -- -- 结构化的器官图(AOG),它捕捉主要地点和周围器官之间的入侵模式,然后进行器官 -- -- 结构 -- -- 跨模式对接(OCA),以便每个器官节点从放射学报告中汇总出文字证据,最后通过通过报告 -- -- 强化图形 -- -- 参考(REG)从报告中取出的具体器官入侵提示来改进这一图表的表述,生成一个结合空间证据和文字证据的多模式器官图。 广泛的实验表明,拟议框架在肾上腺素癌的T-分泌方面达到优异性能.

blocks.en: Accurate T-staging in laryngopharyngeal cancer is pivotal for clinical decision-making, as treatment strategies differ markedly between T stages [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] . Early-stage disease (T1–T2) is usually managed with partial laryngectomy, laser resection, or definitive radiotherapy, whereas advanced stages (T3–T4) often require total laryngectomy combined with adjuvant therapies [ 9 , 10 ] . Although the current reference standard relies on biopsy-derived pathology, this process is invasive and time-consuming. Direct CT-based T-staging is therefore attractive as a non-invasive and rapid alternative, but manually reviewing an entire 3-D CT volume remains labor-intensive and subjective: radiologists must track the tumor across tens of axial slices and judge its extension into adjacent organs, and staging accuracy can suffer, especially in borderline cases.
blocks.zh: 由于T阶段的治疗策略明显不同[6、7、8],准确的T-Stage in laryngopharyengeal 癌症是临床决策的关键。 早期疾病(T1-T2)通常通过部分喉切除、激光再剖开或确定放射治疗来管理,而后期(T3-T4)则往往需要将总的喉切除术与辅酶疗法相结合[9,10]. 虽然目前的参考标准依赖于活体心理衍生出病理学,但这一过程是侵入性的并耗费时间的. 直接基于 CT 因此,T-staging作为一种非侵入和快速的替代品具有吸引力,但手动审查一整个3-D CT体积仍然是劳动密集型和主观性的:放射学家必须追踪数十个轴切片的肿瘤并判断其延伸至相邻器官,运行精度会受到影响,特别是在接壤的情况下.

blocks.en: Recent progress in computer-aided diagnosis has encouraged researchers to predict T-stage directly from CT scans. Radiomics-based models have been developed to discriminate between adjacent T-stages (e.g., T2/T3 or T3/T4) [ 11 , 12 ] , and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been used to assess thyroid cartilage invasion, an essential indicator of advanced-stage disease [ 13 , 14 ] . However, these approaches remain unimodal, relying solely on imaging features and ignoring the clinical information documented in routine radiology reports. Given the success of multimodal image–text learning in other medical applications and the absence of such methods for laryngopharyngeal cancer, there is a need for T-staging models that jointly exploit CT scans and their paired radiology reports.
blocks.zh: 最近计算机辅助诊断的进展鼓励研究人员直接从CT扫描中预测T相. 已经开发出以辐射为基础的模型,以区别相邻的T相位(如T2/T3或T3/T4)[11,12],并使用了革命神经网络(CNNs)来评估甲状腺软骨入侵,这是后期疾病的基本指标[13,14]. 然而,这些方法仍然是单式的,完全依靠成像特征,忽略了常规放射报告中记录的临床信息. 鉴于其他医疗应用中的多模式图像-文本学习的成功,以及缺乏治疗喉癌的此类方法,有必要采用T-Stage模型,共同利用CT扫描及其配对放射学报告。

blocks.en: Unlike conventional image classification tasks, T-staging in laryngopharyngeal cancer presents unique challenges that demand anatomy-aware modeling. The larynx is a particularly complex region in head and neck imaging, with numerous critical structures tightly packed into a small space. Tumors typically arise from a primary site and extend into neighboring organs, so staging depends more on this invasion pattern than the tumor in isolation. Nevertheless, existing computational approaches struggle in two key aspects (see Figure 1 ). First, structural relationship modeling : many methods either process whole CT volumes without tumor annotations or rely on labor-intensive tumor segmentation, making it difficult to explicitly represent inter-organ invasion patterns. Second, fine-grained cross-modal alignment : although radiology reports describe clinical findings, current multimodal models usually fuse image and text at a global level (e.g., via cross-attention or feature concatenation) [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] , hindering precise association between specific anatomical structures and their relevant clinical descriptions. These gaps motivate a fundamental question: how can we integrate organ-level CT context and radiology reports into a unified, anatomy-structured multimodal representation for laryngopharyngeal T-staging?
blocks.zh: 与传统的图像分级任务不同,T-Stage in laryngopharyngeal crain 提出了独特的挑战,需要解剖意识模型. 喉部是头部和颈部成像中特别复杂的区域,许多临界结构被紧紧地包裹在一个小空间中. 肿瘤通常来自一个主要地点,并延伸到相邻的器官,因此,与隔离的肿瘤相比,生长更多地取决于这种入侵模式。 然而,现有的计算方法在两个关键方面挣扎(见图1)。 首先,结构关系模型化:许多方法要么在没有肿瘤说明的情况下处理整个CT卷,要么依赖劳动密集型肿瘤分化,因此很难明确代表器官间入侵模式. 第二,精细的跨模式对接 :虽然放射学报告描述了临床发现,但目前的多模式模型通常会在全球范围内(例如通过交叉意向或特征交接)将图像和文字接通[1,2,3,4,5],阻碍了特定解剖结构及其相关临床描述之间的精确联系. 这些空白引发了一个根本问题:我们如何将器官一级的CT上下文和放射学报告纳入一个统一的、解剖结构的多模式的Laryngopharyngeal T-staging中?

blocks.en: To capture the characteristic pattern of tumor spread in laryngopharyngeal cancer, we first construct an Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph (AOG) that explicitly models spatial relationships among key laryngopharyngeal structures. Rather than operating on whole CT volumes or relying on manual tumor delineation, AOG leverages a publicly available pre-trained organ segmentation model [ 15 ] to obtain reliable organ-specific features, taking advantage of the relatively consistent appearance of anatomical structures. Guided by clinical prior knowledge, it distinguishes primary tumor sites from potentially invaded organs and instantiates an anatomy-guided connectivity pattern: primary sites are fully interconnected to encode their internal relationships and are further linked to organs that are likely to be invaded. The resulting organ-level graph representation describes tumor spread as structured interactions between primary sites and surrounding organs, providing an anatomy-aware basis for downstream T-staging.
blocks.zh: 为了捕捉肿瘤在长喉癌中传播的特征规律,我们首先构建了解剖学-分泌器官图(AOG),明确模拟了关键长喉结构之间的空间关系。 AOG不是在全CT体积上操作,也不是依靠人工进行肿瘤分解,而是利用一种公开的预先训练的器官分解模型[15],利用解剖结构相对一致的外观,获得可靠的器官特有特征. 以临床先行知识为取向,将原发肿瘤地与可能被侵入的器官区分开来,并即时地分解出解剖学引导的连通模式:原发地完全互通,以编码其内部关系,并被进一步与可能被侵入的器官相接. 由此产生的器官层次图表示法将肿瘤传播描述为原生地与周围器官之间的有结构的相互作用,为下游T-Stage提供了解剖意识的基础.

blocks.en: Once organ-level structural relationships are captured by our anatomy-structured organ graph (AOG), incorporating textual evidence via fine-grained image–text alignment becomes crucial for comprehensive staging assessment. To this end, we introduce an Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment (OCA) module. OCA provides cross-modal interaction at the organ level: each organ node derived from CT serves as a query over the radiology report and selectively aggregates fine-grained textual evidence that is most relevant to its appearance, location, and suspected involvement, yielding text-enhanced organ representations while keeping the anatomy-guided graph topology unchanged. This design naturally raises a question: since radiology reports often contain explicit statements about which organs are invaded, why not construct the organ graph directly from these documented invasion relationships instead of linking all anatomically at-risk organs?
blocks.zh: 一旦器官层面的结构关系被我们的解剖结构器官图(AOG)所记录,通过精细图像-文字相接而纳入文字证据,对于全面的中程评估至关重要。 为此,我们引入了机关-安打-相交式(OCA)模块。 OCA在器官层面提供跨模式的相互作用:从CT衍生出来的每个器官节点都充当放射学报告的查询,并有选择地将与其外观,位置,疑似参与关系最大的精细的文字证据汇总起来,产生文字增强的器官表现,同时使解剖学导图地形保持不变. 这种设计自然引起一个问题:由于放射学报告常常包含关于哪些器官被侵入的明确声明,为什么不直接从这些有记录的入侵关系中构建出器官图来,而不是将所有处于解剖危险的器官联系起来呢?

blocks.en: In practice, however, radiologists typically report only obvious and clinically salient invasion, hence subtle or equivocal extension may be omitted. Relying solely on reported invasion would therefore disconnect organs that are anatomically at risk but not explicitly mentioned, leaving their CT features underutilized. To address this, we retain the anatomy-driven connectivity in AOG and use report information as a high-confidence but incomplete guidance signal. Specifically, we design a Report-Enhanced Graph-Refinement (REG) module that reuses the global report representation as a text node in the graph, employs a large language model (LLM) to identify which organs are explicitly described as invaded in the report, and connects this text node only to primary sites and to those invaded organs, while keeping the original organ–organ edges unchanged. This produces a report-guided organ–text graph in which anatomy-based risk relationships are maintained but selectively strengthened along pathways supported by the report. The resulting multimodal organ graph is then fed into a graph neural network that jointly exploits anatomical and report-derived information to predict laryngopharyngeal T-stage.
blocks.zh: 然而,在实践中,放射学家通常只报告明显和临床突出的入侵,因此可以省略微妙或模棱两可的扩展。 因此,仅仅依靠据报的入侵,就会使那些在解剖学上处于危险、但没有明确提及的器官脱节,从而使它们的CT特征得不到充分利用。 为了解决这个问题,我们在AOG中保留了解剖学驱动的连通性,并将报告信息作为高自信但不完整的指导信号. 具体地说,我们设计了一个“报告强化图表参考”模块,将全球报告表述作为图表中的文本节点重新使用,使用一个大语言模型(LLM)来识别报告中明确描述的哪些器官被入侵,并将这个文本节点仅仅连接到主站点和被入侵的器官,同时保持原器官-器官边缘不变。 这产生了一个以报告为指南的器官 -- -- 文本图,其中保持了以解剖学为基础的风险关系,但沿着报告所支持的道路有选择地得到加强。 由此产生的多模式器官图随后被输入一个图神经网络,该网络将联合利用解剖学和报告生成的信息来预测长喉管T-相.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: ❶ An anatomy-guided, annotation-free multimodal T-staging framework. We propose, to our knowledge, the first multimodal laryngopharyngeal cancer T-staging framework that constructs an organ-level graph from pre-trained organ segmentations and integrates paired radiology reports without requiring manual tumor masks, making it practical for full 3D volumes in routine clinical workflows. ❷ Reframing T-staging as anatomy-structured multimodal prediction. We cast laryngopharyngeal cancer T-staging as prediction over an anatomy-structured organ graph that combines CT-derived organ features with organ-level textual cues. By focusing on inter-organ relationships and invasion patterns rather than treating the tumor in isolation, our model is designed to capture key patterns of disease involvement across critical laryngopharyngeal structures. ❸ Comprehensive empirical validation on a multi-center cohort. We conduct extensive experiments on a cohort of 656 patients from four hospitals (to our knowledge, the largest laryngopharyngeal T-staging dataset with paired CT and radiology reports), in both binary (T1–T2 vs. T3–T4) and three-class settings, and evaluate generalization on internal and external test sets, demonstrating consistent improvements over strong imaging-only and multimodal baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下: 一个解剖学导出,无注释的多式T-Stage框架. 据我们所知,我们提议采用第一个多模式的喉癌T-结扎框架,从预先训练过的器官分解中构建出器官水平图,并整合配对的放射学报告,而不需要手动肿瘤口罩,这使得在常规临床工作流程中全3D卷成为实用. · 将T-Stage作为解剖结构的多模式预测。 我们把喉咙癌T-Stage 当作对解剖学结构器官图的预测, 将CT-衍生出器官特征与器官层面的文字提示结合起来。 通过注重组织间关系和入侵模式,而不是孤立地治疗肿瘤,我们的模型旨在捕捉关键喉管结构中涉及疾病的关键模式。 关于多中心组群的全面经验验证。 我们对来自四所医院的656名病人进行了广泛的实验(据我们所知,这是最大的长喉杆形T- staging数据集,配对CT和放射学报告),在二进制(T1-T2对T3-T4)和三等设置中都进行了试验,并评价内部和外部测试集的通用性,表明在强效成像和多模式基线方面不断改进。

blocks.en: An anatomy-guided, annotation-free multimodal T-staging framework. We propose, to our knowledge, the first multimodal laryngopharyngeal cancer T-staging framework that constructs an organ-level graph from pre-trained organ segmentations and integrates paired radiology reports without requiring manual tumor masks, making it practical for full 3D volumes in routine clinical workflows.
blocks.zh: 一个解剖学导出,无注释的多式T-Stage框架. 据我们所知,我们提议采用第一个多模式的喉癌T-结扎框架,从预先训练的器官分解中构建出器官水平图并整合配对的放射科报告,而不需要手动肿瘤口罩,使常规临床工作流程中全3D卷实用.

blocks.en: Reframing T-staging as anatomy-structured multimodal prediction. We cast laryngopharyngeal cancer T-staging as prediction over an anatomy-structured organ graph that combines CT-derived organ features with organ-level textual cues. By focusing on inter-organ relationships and invasion patterns rather than treating the tumor in isolation, our model is designed to capture key patterns of disease involvement across critical laryngopharyngeal structures.
blocks.zh: 将T-Stage重塑为解剖学结构多模式预测. 我们把喉咙癌T-Stage 当作对解剖学结构器官图的预测, 将CT-衍生出器官特征与器官层面的文字提示结合起来。 通过注重组织间关系和入侵模式,而不是孤立地治疗肿瘤,我们的模型旨在捕捉关键喉管结构中涉及疾病的关键模式。

blocks.en: Comprehensive empirical validation on a multi-center cohort. We conduct extensive experiments on a cohort of 656 patients from four hospitals (to our knowledge, the largest laryngopharyngeal T-staging dataset with paired CT and radiology reports), in both binary (T1–T2 vs. T3–T4) and three-class settings, and evaluate generalization on internal and external test sets, demonstrating consistent improvements over strong imaging-only and multimodal baselines.
blocks.zh: 多中心组群的全面经验验证. 我们对来自四所医院的656名病人进行了广泛的实验(据我们所知,这是最大的长喉杆形T- staging数据集,配对CT和放射学报告),在二进制(T1-T2对T3-T4)和三等设置中都进行了试验,并评价内部和外部测试集的通用性,表明在强效成像和多模式基线方面不断改进。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A T-staging
blocks.zh: II-A 图示

blocks.en:
T-staging is a key component of cancer staging, describing the size, extent, and invasion depth of the primary tumor. Accurate staging is vital for diagnosis, treatment planning, and prognosis evaluation. CT, MRI, PET and endoscopic ultrasound are widely applied in clinical practice. Recent advances in deep learning have spurred interest in automating T-staging of cancers based on various imaging modalities.
For rectal cancer, Han et al. [ 16 ] employ a convolutional neural network (CNN) to predict T-stage from CT, capturing subtle infiltration cues. Zhang et al. [ 17 ] propose a tensor graph network exploiting spatial–structural information for improved segmentation-based staging. Dong et al. [ 18 ] develop a cross-domain mutual-assistance framework for nasopharyngeal cancer, and further introduced interpretable dual-branch networks (IPNet) for endoscopic ultrasound-based rectal T-staging.
In prostate cancer, Ogino et al. [ 19 ] present a feature space transfer model using MRI to address domain adaptation and enhance robustness. For head and neck cancers, Gilbert et al. [ 20 ] compare standard and dedicated laryngopharyngeal CT for staging accuracy, while Kuno et al. [ 9 ] review CT, MRI, and dual-energy CT applications. Liu et al. [ 11 ] build a radiomics-based classifier to distinguish T2 from T3 in laryngopharyngeal cancer (LHSCC), and Chen et al. [ 6 ] achieve improved laryngopharyngeal cancer staging via multimodal fusion of radiomics and deep learning using CT. These laryngopharyngeal and head-and-neck staging studies, however, are single-center, limited in scale (118–319 patients), and rely on imaging features alone without exploiting paired radiology reports. Despite the progress, laryngopharyngeal cancer staging remains challenging due to complex invasion patterns, limited CT resolution and contrast, and insufficient structural modeling in current algorithms. We address these gaps with a multimodal framework that integrates anatomical relationship modeling and textual evidence, aiming to enhance fine-grained invasion characterization and T-staging accuracy.

[6] 通过多模式聚变放射素并使用CT进行深层学习,改善长喉癌的形成。 然而,这些喉咙和头部和颈部的中枢研究是单中心研究,规模有限(118-319名病人),仅依靠成像特征,而不利用配对放射学报告。 尽管取得了这些进展,但由于入侵模式复杂,CT分辨率和对比度有限,以及当前算法的结构模型分析不足,长喉癌的形成仍然具有挑战性。 我们用一个将解剖关系模型和文字证据相结合的多模式框架来弥补这些差距,目的是提高精细的入侵特征和T-稳定准确性。

blocks.en: II-B Multi-modal Learning
blocks.zh: II-B 多式联运

blocks.en:
Multi-modal learning leverages complementary information from diverse data modalities and has shown strong potential in clinical diagnosis and medical image analysis [ 21 , 22 ] . By integrating medical images with textual reports, such models capture richer semantic representations, improving both diagnostic accuracy and interpretability [ 23 , 24 ] . Recent studies have explored vision–language integration for medical imaging. TP-DRSeg [ 25 ] injects medical prior knowledge from text into a vision-only segmentation network, while TextDiff [ 26 ] enriches diffusion models with text annotations to align semantic features and descriptions. SimTxtSeg [ 27 ] converts textual prompts into visual ones via hybrid attention, and TextMatch [ 28 ] leverages text prompts for semi-supervised segmentation. Beyond segmentation, multimodal fusion has been applied to disease detection: MMBCD [ 1 ] combines mammograms with clinical history to associate text embeddings with visual regions for breast cancer detection; MEDBind [ 29 ] anchors tri-modal binding of chest X-rays, ECG signals, and textual data; TQx [ 30 ] aligns pathology images and text using vision–language pre-training to improve quantitative analysis.
Architectures for deeper fusion include TGCAM [ 2 ] , which uses text-guided common attention with iterative text refinement, and MMI [ 3 ] , which matches and fuses image–text features through cross-attention for chest lesion segmentation. Overall, integrating visual and textual modalities yields clear benefits for medical imaging. However, for fine-grained clinical tasks such as laryngopharyngeal cancer T-staging, existing methods struggle to model anatomical relationships and achieve precise cross-modal correspondence between structures and descriptions. To address these issues, we propose an anatomy-aware multimodal framework that jointly models anatomical structure and fine-grained alignment to enhance T-staging performance.

blocks.en: III-A Overview
blocks.zh: 三. A 概览

blocks.en: The proposed anatomy-aware fine-grained multimodal framework for laryngopharyngeal cancer T-staging using CT images and radiology reports is illustrated in Figure 2 . Our framework comprises three key components: an Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph (AOG) , an Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment (OCA) module, and a Report-Enhanced Graph-Refinement (REG) module. First, AOG addresses the challenge of modeling complex invasion patterns by using pre-trained organ segmentations and anatomy-guided connectivity rules to construct an organ-level graph that encodes potential spread between primary sites and surrounding structures. OCA then performs fine-grained, organ-level image–text interaction, enhancing CT-derived organ features with organ-specific cues from the radiology report while preserving the anatomy-driven topology. Finally, REG uses a large language model (LLM) to incorporate report-derived invasion statements as a guidance signal on top of AOG, refining the multimodal organ graph without discarding anatomy-based risk connections. In the following sections, we describe these three components in detail.

blocks.en: III-B Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph

blocks.en: Motivation. Current approaches for laryngopharyngeal cancer T-staging either process whole CT volumes without explicit anatomical constraints or rely on manual tumor segmentation. Both strategies struggle to capture the progressive, anatomy-structured spread of tumor invasion from primary sites to surrounding organs:
blocks.zh: 动机 目前对喉癌T- staging的治疗方法要么在没有明显的解剖限制的情况下处理整个CT卷,要么依靠人工肿瘤分解。 两种策略都试图捕捉肿瘤入侵从主要地点到周围器官的渐进、解剖结构的传播:

blocks.en: Missing anatomy-structured invasion context: Operating on global volumes or isolated tumor masks without an explicit organ-level graph underrepresents the relationships between primary sites and anatomically at-risk organs, limiting the ability to reason about stage-defining invasion patterns.
blocks.zh: 缺少解剖结构入侵背景: 在没有明确器官水平图的情况下操作全球卷或孤立的肿瘤口罩,低估了主站点与解剖风险器官之间的关系,限制了对阶段性入侵模式进行推理的能力.

blocks.en: Missing anatomy-structured invasion context: Operating on global volumes or isolated tumor masks without an explicit organ-level graph underrepresents the relationships between primary sites and anatomically at-risk organs, limiting the ability to reason about stage-defining invasion patterns.
blocks.zh: 缺少解剖结构入侵背景: 在没有明确器官水平图的情况下操作全球卷或孤立的肿瘤口罩,低估了主站点与解剖风险器官之间的关系,限制了对阶段性入侵模式进行推理的能力.

blocks.en: To address this, we observe that pre-trained organ segmentation models provide reliable anatomical anchors due to the relatively consistent appearance of laryngopharyngeal and surrounding structures. Combined with clinical prior knowledge about typical routes of spread, this motivates constructing an Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph (AOG) that explicitly encodes organ-level relationships between primary sites and all anatomically plausible invasion targets, rather than relying solely on tumor masks or reported invasion.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们发现,由于喉管和周围结构的外观相对一致,经过预先训练的器官分解模型提供了可靠的解剖锚. 结合临床上对典型传播途径的知识,这促使人们构建出解剖学 -- -- 结构化器官图(AOG),明确编码主要地点和所有解剖上可信的入侵目标之间的器官层面关系,而不是仅仅依赖肿瘤口罩或报告入侵。

blocks.en: III-B 1 Organ-specific Feature Extraction
blocks.zh: III-B 1 特定器官特征

blocks.en: Effective feature extraction from 3D CT volumes poses significant challenges in laryngopharyngeal cancer staging. The high dimensionality of volumetric data combined with the relatively small size of tumor regions makes it difficult to capture discriminative features directly from whole CT scans. While tumor segmentation seems like a natural solution, the heterogeneous appearance of tumors and the requirement for labor-intensive annotations limit its practical application.
blocks.zh: 从3D CT体积中提取出有效特征,给长喉癌的形成带来了重大挑战。 量子数据的高维度,加上肿瘤区域相对较小,因此很难直接从整个CT扫描中捕捉到有区别的特征. 虽然肿瘤分解似乎是一种自然的解决方案,但肿瘤的不同外观以及对劳动密集型说明的要求限制了其实际应用.

blocks.en: III-C Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment
blocks.zh: III-C 机关-安打相通

blocks.en: Motivation. Current approaches for integrating medical images and reports typically rely on global feature fusion, where CT volumes and entire reports are encoded into holistic embeddings and fused at a coarse level. Such strategies overlook the organ-level structure that is present in both modalities:
blocks.zh: 动机 目前整合医疗图像和报告的方法通常依赖于全球特征组合,其中CT卷和整个报告被编码成整体嵌入并被粗放地融合. 这些战略忽略了两种模式中存在的机构一级结构:

blocks.en: Coarse image–text Alignment: Global fusion methods cannot reliably associate specific anatomical structures with their relevant clinical descriptions in the radiology report, leaving organ features weakly grounded in textual evidence.
blocks.zh: 粗体图像 - 文本 对齐:全球聚变方法不能可靠地将具体的解剖结构与放射学报告中的相关临床描述联系起来,使得器官特征在文字证据上基础薄弱.

blocks.en: Coarse image–text Alignment: Global fusion methods cannot reliably associate specific anatomical structures with their relevant clinical descriptions in the radiology report, leaving organ features weakly grounded in textual evidence.
blocks.zh: 粗体图像 - 文本 对齐:全球聚变方法不能可靠地将具体的解剖结构与放射学报告中的相关临床描述联系起来,使得器官特征在文字证据上基础薄弱.

blocks.en: To address this, we let organ nodes from CT serve as queries over the report and propose an Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment (OCA) module that performs fine-grained image–text interaction at the organ level, yielding text-enhanced organ representations that remain consistent with the anatomy-structured organ graph.

blocks.en: Building upon the anatomical topology constructed in Section III.B, we now focus on enhancing organ representations with complementary information from radiology reports. Effective encoding of radiology reports requires careful consideration of medical domain knowledge and terminology. Unlike general text processing tasks, radiology reports contain specialized medical vocabulary and context-dependent descriptions of anatomical structures. To accurately capture this domain-specific information, we employ a pre-trained biomedical language model , specifically BioBERT [ 33 ] ( dmis-lab/biobert-base-cased-v1.2 ) .

blocks.en: With organ-specific visual features and textual representations available, a key challenge is how to establish precise correspondence between them. Unlike conventional approaches that apply global feature fusion, we propose an organ-guided attention mechanism where organ features actively query relevant textual descriptions.

blocks.en: Motivation. Radiology reports often contain explicit statements about which organs are invaded. However, when report information is used only at the feature level (e.g., to enhance organ embeddings), these discrete invasion findings do not directly influence the structure of the organ graph: all anatomically at-risk organs remain connected in the same way, regardless of whether they are documented as invaded.

Unlike previous approaches that treat textual information as auxiliary features, our text node is designed to explicitly encode invasion relationships described in the reports.

blocks.en: IV-A Dataset
blocks.zh: 四-A 数据集

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, we collect the first and largest dataset for CT-based laryngopharyngeal cancer T-staging, comprising 656 patients across four medical centers. More importantly, all cases are paired with CT reports for multimodal T-staging assessment. Our dataset substantially exceeds the scale of previous studies: prior laryngopharyngeal and head-and-neck staging studies are single-center and considerably smaller (118–319 patients [ 11 , 8 , 12 , 6 ] ) and rely on imaging alone without paired radiology reports.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,我们收集了基于CT的肾上腺癌T- staging的第一个也是最大的数据集,由四个医疗中心的656名病人组成。 更重要的是,所有案例都与CT报告配套,用于多式联运T-Stage评估。 我们的数据集大大地超过了以前研究的规模:以前的长喉和头颈中枢研究是单中心研究,规模要小得多(118至319名病人[11、8、12、6]),并且仅依靠成像,而没有对应的放射学报告。

blocks.en: IV-A 1 Dataset Composition and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: IV-A 1 数据集组成和评价议定书

blocks.en:
Our dataset consists of four cohorts: (1) Fudan University Zhongshan Hospital (FUZH) as the primary cohort with 439 patients, each with contrast-enhanced CT scans and corresponding radiology reports; (2) Chang Gung Memorial Hospital (CGMH) with 25 cases; (3) Eye & ENT Hospital of Fudan University (EENT) with 87 cases; and (4) The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) with 105 cases for evaluating generalizability on public data [ 40 ] . All cases are pathologically confirmed with detailed T-staging distributions as shown in Table III .
For TCGA data [ 40 ] , which included only CT scans and pathological-confirmed T-stages, we manually annotated corresponding CT reports following standard radiological assessment protocols. Specifically, these CT reports were written by a board-certified radiologist and then reviewed and verified by a second, with any disagreements resolved by consensus; the radiologists described only imaging findings and did not assign or infer the T-stage. FUZH is used for 5-fold cross-validation, while CGMH, EENT, and TCGA [ 40 ] form the external test set.
blocks.zh:
我们的数据集包括四个组: (1)富丹大学中山医院(FUZH)为439名患者的一等队,每等队有对比增强的CT扫描和相应的放射学报告;(2)昌公纪念医院(CGMH)有25个病例;(3)富丹大学眼科和ENT医院(EENT)有87个病例;(4)癌症基因组图集(TCGA)有105个病例,用于公共数据评价通性[40]. 如表三所示,所有病例均经病理确诊,并有详细的T级分布。
TCGA数据[40],仅包括CT扫描和病理确认的T级数据,我们按照标准放射性评估协议,手动附加说明相应的CT报告. 具体地说,这些CT报告是由经委员会认证的放射学家撰写的,然后由第二人进行审查和核实,任何分歧均以协商一致方式解决;放射学家只描述了成像结果,没有指定或推断T级。 FUZH用于5倍交叉验证,而CGMH,EENT,和TCGA [40]则组成了外部测试集.

blocks.en: Importantly, the ground-truth T-stage labels in our dataset are derived from pathological confirmation following AJCC 8th edition criteria, not from CT reports. None of the 439 training reports contain any T-stage designation — all reports describe imaging findings following standard clinical templates.

blocks.en: We consider two clinically relevant classification settings: (1) Binary classification between early stages (T1–T2) and late stages (T3–T4), reflecting fundamentally different treatment strategies—patients with early-stages receive organ-preserving procedures while advanced cases require aggressive interventions; (2) Three-class classification: T1 vs. T2 vs. T3–T4, where T1 and T2 are distinguished due to different tumor infiltration patterns and recurrence risks, while T3 and T4 are merged considering similar treatment protocols.
blocks.zh: 我们认为有两个临床相关的分类环境: (1) 早期(T1-T2)和后期(T3-T4)的二进制分类,反映了根本不同的治疗策略——早期病人接受器官保存程序,而后期病人需要积极的干预;(2) 三等分类:T1对T2对T3-T4,由于肿瘤渗入模式和重现风险不同,T1和T2被区分,而T3和T4则考虑到类似的治疗规程被合并.

blocks.en: IV-B 1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 执行细节

blocks.en: All experiments are conducted using PyTorch [ 41 ] on an NVIDIA H20 GPU. For data preprocessing, all CT volumes are resampled to an isotropic spacing of 1mm 3 and resized to a unified spatial dimension of 128 × \times 128 × \times 128. The intensity values are normalized to the range [0, 1], with Hounsfield Unit normalization applied using a window center of 50 and a window width of 450 to enhance the visibility of soft tissues in clinical settings. We train our model with a batch size of 8 using the Adam optimizer. The learning rate starts at 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} and decays to 1 × 10 − 7 1\times 10^{-7} following a cosine decay schedule, with a weight decay of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} . Organ masks for all four cohorts are produced by the same publicly available pre-trained segmentation model (Continual Segment [ 15 ] , a single unified model covering 143 whole-body organs in CT), applied without any site-specific fine-tuning or adaptation.

blocks.en: IV-C Comparison to State-of-the-Arts
blocks.zh: 与艺术状况的比较

blocks.en:
We compare the proposed method with image-based classification approaches, such as SwinViT [ 37 ] , VDPF [ 38 ] , MRSN [ 39 ] , and several state-of-the-art multimodal learning methods (CPAM [ 5 ] , TGCAM [ 2 ] , MMBCD [ 1 ] , LViT [ 4 ] , MMI [ 3 ] ). The results are summarized in Table II .
Our method demonstrates superior performance across all experimental settings. In the binary classification task (Early T1–T2 vs. Late T3–T4), our method achieves the highest performance on both internal and external test sets. For internal testing, we achieve an F1 score of 80.83% and accuracy of 81.53%, surpassing the second-best method MMI [ 3 ] (77.59% F1 score and 78.57% accuracy). On the external test set, our method maintains its leading position with an F1 score of 76.46% and accuracy of 76.50%, outperforming TGCAM [ 2 ] (74.09% F1 score and 74.38% accuracy) by a significant margin.
For the more challenging three-class classification task (T1, T2, T3–T4), our method also achieves consistent superior performance. On the internal test set, we achieve an F1 score of 61.43% and accuracy of 63.33%, showing notable improvements over MMBCD [ 1 ] (58.44% F1 score and 61.14% accuracy). The advantage is even more prominent on the external test set, where our method achieves an F1 score of 60.27% and accuracy of 63.78%, significantly outperforming the second best method by a large margin of 8.73% F1 score and 7.78% accuracy.

blocks.en: IV-D Ablation Study

blocks.en: IV-D 1 Effectiveness of Individual Components
blocks.zh: IV-D 1 单个组成部分的有效性

blocks.en:
We conduct comprehensive ablation studies to evaluate the contribution of each key component in our framework. As shown in Table IV , we systematically analyze different combinations of the three
main modules: Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph (AOG), Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment (OCA), and Report-Enhanced Graph-Refinement (REG). The baseline model, which directly processes the whole CT volume for prediction
without any anatomical guidance or textual information, achieves only 58.76% and 39.16% macro F1-scores in binary and three-class settings, respectively. Adding AOG substantially
improves the performance (77.96% and 52.80% F1-scores), demonstrating that explicitly modeling organ-level relationships helps capture tumor invasion patterns. When applying the OCA
module alone, the performance further increases to 80.97% and 58.47% for binary and three-class settings, which validates our
hypothesis that fine-grained organ–text alignment provides valuable diagnostic evidence from radiology reports. When combining AOG and OCA, we observe further performance gains (81.63% and 61.52% F1-scores), suggesting that
anatomical structure and textual evidence complement each other. Finally, incorporating REG on top of both AOG and OCA yields the best overall performance, with macro F1-scores of
83.96% and 64.53% in binary and three-class settings, indicating that the structured parsing of invasion information from reports further enhances the graph-based representation.
These results comprehensively validate the effectiveness of our proposed modules in improving T-staging accuracy. To quantify the uncertainty of these comparisons, each ablation configuration is run over three random seeds and reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation (Table IV ). On the binary task the macro-F1 is AOG 77.96 ± \pm 1.23, OCA 80.97 ± \pm 1.28, AOG+OCA 81.63 ± \pm 1.71, and the full model 83.96 ± \pm 0.50; the full model attains both the highest mean and the smallest variance, and REG yields a further improvement over AOG+OCA.

blocks.en: IV-D 2 Impact of Text Encoder Freezing
blocks.zh: IV-D 2 文本编码器被冻结的影响

blocks.en: We investigate the influence of text encoder fine-tuning strategies on model performance. As shown in Figure 3 , we compare two settings: freezing the text encoder parameters and fine-tuning them during training. For the binary classification task, the fine-tuned encoder achieves slightly better performance on both internal validation (81.46% vs. 80.83% F1-score) and external testing (77.77% vs. 76.46% F1-score) sets. Similarly, in the three-class setting, both strategies yield comparable results, with frozen encoder showing marginal advantages (61.43% vs. 60.79% on internal validation, 60.27% vs. 58.33% on external testing). The minimal performance difference between frozen and fine-tuned settings suggests that the pre-trained text encoder already captures robust medical language representations. This observation is particularly valuable from a practical perspective, as freezing the text encoder not only reduces computational costs but also helps prevent potential overfitting on our specific dataset. Therefore, we adopt the frozen text encoder strategy in our final framework.
blocks.zh: 我们调查文本编码器微调策略对模型性能的影响. 如图3所示,我们比较了两个设置:冻结文本编码器参数并在训练期间对其进行微调. 对于二进制分类任务,微调编码器在内部验证(81.46%对80.83%的F1-分数)和外部测试(77.77%对76.46%的F1-分数)两套上都取得了略好的表现. 同样,在三等环境下,两种战略都产生类似的结果,冷冻编码器显示边际优势(内部验证为61.43%对60.79%,外部测试为60.27%对58.33%)。 冷冻和微调设置之间最小的性能差异表明,经过预训的文本编码器已经捕捉出强健的医学语言表达. 从实际角度看,这一观察特别有价值,因为冻结文本编码器不仅会降低计算成本,而且有助于防止我们的具体数据集可能过于匹配。 因此,我们在最后框架内通过了被冻结的案文编码器战略。

blocks.en: IV-D 3 Effectiveness of Individual Invaded Organs
blocks.zh: IV-D 3 个人侵入器官的效力

blocks.en: To validate the importance of invaded organs in T-staging prediction, we conduct experiments comparing the performance of models trained on individual invaded organs against global CT volume processing. As shown in Figure 4 , surprisingly, models focusing on single invaded organs often outperform the global approach. Particularly, the thyroid-focused model demonstrates the strongest performance, achieving average F1-scores of 0.716 (internal) and 0.582 (external), significantly surpassing the global baseline’s 0.588 (internal) and 0.436 (external). Models focusing on the trachea and esophagus also show consistent advantages over global processing, while the oral cavity model exhibits comparable performance. These results are noteworthy because these invaded organs may not contain the primary tumor site, yet they provide reliable staging predictions. This phenomenon can be attributed to two factors: (1) The invasion status of these organs serves as a strong indicator for T-staging, as specific organ involvement directly correlates with staging criteria (e.g., thyroid invasion indicating advanced stage disease). (2) Compared to processing the entire CT volume, focusing on individual organs provides more precise anatomical context, reducing the interference from irrelevant regions. These findings not only validate our anatomically-informed approach but also suggest that targeted analysis of key invaded organs could be a promising direction for efficient T-staging.
blocks.zh: 为了验证入侵器官在T-staging预测中的重要性,我们进行实验,比较单个入侵器官方面训练的模型与全球CT量处理的性能. 如图4所示,令人惊讶的是,注重单一被侵入的器官的模式往往比全球方法要好。 特别是,以甲状腺为重点的模型表现出最强的表现,平均F1-分数为0.716(内部)和0.582(外部),大大超过全球基线的0.588(内部)和0.436(外部)。 以气管和食道为重点的模型也显示出与全球加工相比的一贯优势,而口腔模型表现出相仿的性能. 这些结果值得一提,因为这些被侵入的器官可能没有主要肿瘤原位,但它们提供了可靠的演化预测。 这种现象可归因于两个因素: (1) 这些器官的入侵状况是T-Stage的有力指标,因为具体的器官参与与中转标准(如甲状腺入侵表明晚期疾病)直接相关。 (2)与处理整个CT卷相比,专注于单个器官提供了更精确的解剖上下文,减少了来自无关区域的干扰. 这些调查结果不仅证实了我们解剖学上知情的方法,而且表明,对被侵入的主要器官进行有针对性的分析,可以成为高效的T-稳定的一个有希望的方向。

blocks.en: IV-E Robustness to Organ Segmentation Noise and Report Variation
blocks.zh: IV-E 对器官分块的强力性 噪音和报告变化

blocks.en: Since our framework relies on pre-trained organ segmentation to define cropping regions, we evaluate its sensitivity to segmentation errors through a mask perturbation experiment. Starting from the existing auto-segmentation outputs (not ground-truth masks), we apply additional random perturbations to each organ’s mask independently: the perturbation direction (dilation or erosion) is randomly chosen per organ, and the magnitude is proportional to the organ’s size so that small organs receive smaller absolute perturbations and large organs receive larger ones. As shown in Fig. 5 (a), the F1 score decreases by only 1.1% and 2.8% under 5% and 10% perturbation levels respectively, confirming that our region-based cropping design is robust to realistic segmentation errors. Since the baseline itself already contains segmentation errors from the automated model, the perturbed conditions represent compounded noise levels beyond what would occur in practice.
blocks.zh: 因为我们的框架依靠预先训练的器官分解来定义收割区域,所以我们通过口罩扰动实验来评价其对分解错误的敏感性. 从现有的自动分隔输出(不是地上真口罩)开始,我们独立地对每个器官的口罩施加额外的随机扰动:每个器官随机选择扰动方向(分化或侵蚀),而大小与器官大小成正比,这样小器官得到的绝对扰动较小,而大器官得到的则较大. 如图5(a)所示,F1的分数分别下降1.1%和2.8%,低于5%和10%的扰动水平,这证实了我们以区域为基础的收成设计对现实的分化错误是强有力的。 由于基准本身已经包含自动化模型的分解错误,扰动条件代表了超出实际发生的复杂噪音水平。

blocks.en: Robustness to report detail and completeness. Beyond segmentation noise, we assess the framework’s sensitivity to variation in how radiology reports are written. We rewrite each report with a large language model (Claude Haiku), keeping every medical term and measurement verbatim and altering only the level of detail: a less-detailed version drops non-diagnostic content (scan parameters, boilerplate, and routine non-invasion negative statements) while retaining the primary subsite, tumor size, and all positive and negative invasion statements, and a more-detailed version restates the same findings in more elaborate clinical language without adding new information, reflecting the terse and verbose reporting styles seen across radiologists in practice. The same CT images and the frozen model are held fixed throughout. As shown in Fig. 5 (b), macro-F1 stays within 80.4–82.1% and accuracy within 81.8–83.0% across the original and both perturbed conditions (at most a 1.7-point change in macro-F1). This indicates that the framework is resilient to the level of detail and completeness of the input report.
blocks.zh: 有能力报告细节和完整性。 除了分解噪音之外,我们评估框架对放射科报告编写方式变化的敏感性。 我们用一个大语言模型(Claude Haiku)改写每份报告,保留每一个医学术语和测量,并且只改变详细程度:一个不太详细的版本会降低非诊断性的内容(扫描参数、锅炉板和例行非入侵性负面陈述),同时保留主要的子站点、肿瘤大小以及所有正面和负面的入侵陈述,一个更加详细的版本在更详尽的临床语言中重复同样的发现,而不添加新的信息,反映出实际上在放射学家中看到的字节和动词报告风格。 同样的CT图像和被冻结的模型被固定在了整个过程中. 如图5(b)所示,宏观F1在原始条件和扰动条件中都保持在80.4-82.1%以内,精度在81.8-83.0%以内(宏观F1最多为1.7分变化)。 这表明,该框架能够适应投入报告的详细程度和完整性。

blocks.en: IV-F Superiority of AOG
blocks.zh: AOG的优越性

blocks.en: To validate the effectiveness of our Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph (AOG), we conduct ablation studies comparing different approaches for modeling anatomical relationships. As shown in Table VI , we compare our method with three baseline approaches: 1) Fully-Connected Graph, which models organ relationships using a complete graph where all nodes are directly connected; 2) Direct Fusion, which simply concatenates all relevant organ masks as input; and 3) Global Context, which uses global feature pooling to capture contextual information. The results demonstrate the clear advantages of our AOG approach. Specifically, our method achieves significant improvements over all baselines, with F1 scores of 77.76% and 73.33% on internal and external tests respectively. This represents improvements of 3.85% and 4.33% over the strongest baseline (Fully-Connected Graph) in F1 score. The performance gap is even larger when compared to Direct Fusion and Global Context approaches, showing gains of over 15% in some metrics. These results validate our design choice in AOG that selectively models anatomical relationships through learned attention mechanisms rather than using either oversimplified global context or potentially noisy fully-connected connections. The consistent superior performance on both internal and external tests also demonstrates the robustness and generalizability of our approach in capturing meaningful anatomical topology information.
blocks.zh: 为了验证我们的解剖学 -- -- 断层器官图(AOG)的有效性,我们进行了对比不同方法的断层研究,以模拟解剖关系。 如表六所示,我们的方法与三个基线方法作了比较: 1) Fully-Connected Graph,该图使用所有节点直接连接的完整图来模拟器官关系; 2)直接融合,它简单地将所有相关的器官口罩做为输入; 3) Global Control,它使用全局特性集合来获取上下文信息. 结果表明,我们会计组的做法有明显的好处。 具体来说,我们的方法在所有基线上都取得了显著的改进,在内部和外部测试中F1的分数分别为77.76%和73.33%. 这比F1分中最强基线(Fully-Connected Graph)提高3.85%和4.33%. 与 " 直接融合 " 和 " 全球背景 " 方法相比,绩效差距更大,在某些衡量标准中,收益超过15%。 这些结果验证了我们在AOG中的设计选择,即有选择地通过学到的注意机制模拟解剖关系,而不是使用过度简化的全球背景或可能吵闹的完全连接。 内部和外部测试的一贯优异表现也表明,我们在获取有意义的解剖学地貌信息方面的做法是稳健而普遍的。

blocks.en: IV-G Superiority of OCA
blocks.zh: OCA的优越性

blocks.en: To validate the effectiveness of our Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment (OCA), we conduct comprehensive comparisons with several attention-based variants on both internal and external test sets. As shown in Table V , our proposed method consistently outperforms other attention mechanisms across both settings. For internal testing, our method achieves the highest F1 score of 81.93% and accuracy of 82.95%, surpassing the Global+Attention baseline by 6.48% and 5.68% respectively. More importantly, on the external test set, our method maintains strong performance with 76.10% F1 score and 76.50% accuracy, demonstrating a significant improvement of 7.63% and 7.84% over the baseline. The superior performance on both internal and external tests validates that our OCA can effectively capture the fine-grained interactions between organ features and text descriptions, while maintaining good generalization ability. Fig. 6 illustrates OCA cross-attention weights for three cases of different T-stages: the early-stage case (T1) attends primarily to anatomical location terms (“supraglottic,” “epiglottis”); the T2 case shows cross-organ attention as the Subglottic node attends to adjacent structure tokens; and the advanced case (T3) concentrates on invasion-related keywords (“invades,” “cartilage”). These visualizations offer interpretable evidence for how OCA utilizes report text at the organ level.
blocks.zh: 为了验证我们的机关-安托万-莫达尔对接(OCA)的有效性,我们在内部和外部测试中与几个基于注意力的变体进行全面比较。 如表五所显示的,我们提议的方法在两种情况下都一贯优于其他关注机制。 就内部测试而言,我们的方法达到了最高的F1分,为81.93%,精度为82.95%,分别超过Global+Attention基线6.48%和5.68%. 更重要的是,在外部测试中,我们的方法保持了强劲的性能,F1得分为76.10%,精度为76.50%,显示出比基线显著提高7.63%和7.84%. 在内部和外部测试上的优异表现证明,我们的OCA能够有效地捕捉到器官特征和文本描述之间的精细的相互作用,同时保持良好的概括能力. 图6说明了OCA对三个不同T阶段的交叉注意权重:早期案件(T1)主要涉及解剖位置术语(“supraglottic,”“Epiglottis”);T2案件显示跨组织注意,因为子格洛特克节点处理相邻的结构标志;高级案件(T3)集中处理与入侵有关的关键词(“入侵,”“卡通”)。 这些可视化为OCA如何在机关一级使用报告文本提供了可解释的证据。

blocks.en: IV-H Clinical Validation
blocks.zh: IV-H 临床鉴定

blocks.en: IV-H 1 Comparison with Radiologists
blocks.zh: IV-H 1 与放射学家的比较

blocks.en: Table VII shows the comparison results of our method and two radiologists on an external test set. For this evaluation, we randomly selected 20 samples from each class, comprising 80 samples in total for the comparison. The proposed method demonstrates competitive performance with the radiologists in both experimental settings. In the Early vs Late classification, our method achieves an F1 score of 76.25% and accuracy of 76.25%, performing comparably to Radiologists 1 and 2, who achieve F1 scores of 76.16% and 74.98%, and accuracies of 76.25% and 75.00%, respectively. In the T1, T2, Late (T3–T4) classification, our method achieves an F1 score of 59.71% and an accuracy of 62.50%, outperforming both radiologists by at least 6.08% in F1 score and 2.50% in accuracy. These results confirm the effectiveness of our method in predicting laryngopharyngeal cancer T-staging, demonstrating performance on par with or exceeding experienced radiologists. The three representative cases in Fig. 7 demonstrate that, despite potential errors by experienced clinicians, our model correctly performs the T-staging task, showing strong precision and robustness.

blocks.en: IV-H 2 Failure Mode Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-H 2 失败模式分析

blocks.en: We analyzed the 16 misclassified cases (out of 88 test samples) in Fold 1 and identified two dominant failure patterns inherently linked to the limitations of CT-based invasion assessment. Over-staging (9/16 cases, 56%): the model predicted T3–T4 for pathologically confirmed T1–T2 cases. In 7 of these 9 cases, the radiology report explicitly described cartilage invasion that was not confirmed by pathological examination, reflecting CT’s known limitation in distinguishing tumor contact from true cartilage invasion [ 14 , 7 ] . Under-staging (7/16 cases, 44%): the model predicted T1–T2 for pathologically confirmed T3–T4 cases. In 5 of these 7 cases, the report contained no invasion description or explicitly stated “no evidence of invasion,” despite pathological confirmation. These complementary failure modes highlight an inherent challenge: CT-based assessment can both over-estimate and under-estimate invasion relative to pathological ground truth. Three representative failure cases are shown in Fig. 7 .
blocks.zh: 我们分析了(88个测试样本中的)Fold 1中的16个错误分类案例,并确定了两种与基于CT的入侵评估的局限性固有的主要故障模式。 过度悬浮(9/16个病例,56%):模型预测T3-T4病理确诊T1-T2病例. 在这9个病例中的7个病例中,放射学报告明确描述了未经病理检查证实的软骨入侵,反映了CT在区分肿瘤接触和真正的软骨入侵[14,7]方面的已知局限性. 积分不足(7/16例,44%):模型预测为病理确诊的T3-T4病例为T1-T2. 在这7个案件中,有5个案件的报告没有关于入侵的描述,也没有明确指出“没有入侵的证据”,尽管有病理学的证实。 这些互补的失败模式凸显出一个固有的挑战:基于CT的评估可以相对于病理地真相,高估和低估入侵. 图7显示了三个有代表性的失败案例。

blocks.en: Cross-modal alignment analysis of failures. We further examine the misclassified cases in the shared representation space, quantifying the OCA cross-attention mass that the potentially-invaded organ nodes (esophagus, thyroid gland, trachea, oral cavity) place on invasion-related report tokens (Table VIII ). On correctly classified cases the alignment behaves as intended, with low values for true early-stage (0.058) and high values for true advanced-stage cases (0.105). Notably, over-staged cases do exhibit an elevated invasion-token alignment (0.088); this arises because the corresponding reports genuinely contain invasion descriptions that are CT-derived false positives (cf. the cartilage discordance in Table IX ), which the cross-modal fusion faithfully incorporates, rather than over-associating invasion with unrelated features. In under-staged cases the alignment is as low as in true early-stage cases (0.058), consistent with these being CT false negatives in which the report records no positive invasion finding and the CT shows none, so no genuine invasion evidence is available for the organ features to bind to. These errors arise from discordance between the available CT/report evidence and the pathological ground truth, which the fusion transmits faithfully rather than mis-aligning. We acknowledge that, because the fusion integrates report evidence, an unreliable invasion description can occasionally tip a borderline case in this misclassified subset. This effect is bounded, however: the prediction is grounded in imaging and enhanced by the report rather than dictated by it, with the image-only AOG variant already attaining 77.96% F1 (Table IV ) and the report refining this to 83.96%. Future work could mitigate these failures through uncertainty-aware fusion that down-weights unreliable invasion descriptions, uncertainty-aware prediction that flags borderline cases for clinical review, and multi-center training to improve cross-institutional generalizability.
blocks.zh: 对失败进行跨模式对接分析。 我们进一步审查了在共同代表空间中被误分类的案件,量化了可能入侵的器官节点(食道、甲状腺、气管、口腔)在与入侵有关的报告信使上所显示的OCA交叉注意的质量(表八)。 在正确分类的案件中,校正行为符合预期,真正的早期(0.058)数值较低,真正的后期(0.105)数值较高。 值得注意的是,阶段过长的案件确实表现出较高的入侵吻合度(0.088);这是因为相应的报告确实载有入侵描述,这些描述是CT产生的虚假阳性(参见表九中的软骨不和),而交叉式聚变忠实地纳入了入侵,而不是过度地将入侵与无关特征联系在一起。 在未进入阶段的案件中,校正率与真正处于早期阶段的案件(0.058)一样低,这与报告未记录正面入侵结果的CT假阴性相符,CT也没有,因此没有真正的入侵证据使器官特征具有约束性。 这些错误出自现有的CT/报告证据与病理地基真理之间的不和,核聚变忠实地传递而非错配. 我们承认,由于核聚变整合了报告的证据,不可靠的入侵描述偶尔会给这个被错误分类的子集中的分界线案例倾斜. 然而,这种影响是有限的:预测以成像为基础,并由报告加强,而不是由报告来决定,只有图像的AOG变体已经达到77.96%的F1(表四),报告将这一变体改进为83.96%。 未来工作可以通过以下方式来减轻这些失败:不确定性意识聚变,降低重量的入侵描述不可靠;不确定性意识预测,标出临床审查的边缘病例;多中心培训,以提高跨机构通用性。

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: Robustness to Organ Segmentation. Head-and-neck organ segmentation is a relatively mature task, with Dice scores of 80–95% routinely achievable for most anatomical structures [ 31 , 15 ] . Moreover, our method uses organ masks only to locate cropping regions, so small boundary errors merely shift the crop window without excluding organ content. The mask perturbation experiment (Fig. 5 (a)) confirms this robustness, with only 2.8% F1 degradation under ± \pm 10% proportional boundary noise.
blocks.zh: 强健到器官分裂。 头颈器官分化是一项相对成熟的任务,对大多数解剖结构来说,Dice分数为80-95%的常规可实现性[31,15]. 此外,我们的方法只使用器官口罩来定位收割地段,所以小的边界误差只是转移收割地窗口而不排除器官含量. 口罩扰动实验(图5 (a))证实了这种稳健性,在±\pm 10%的比例边界噪声下只有2.8%的F1降解.

blocks.en: Report–T-stage Independence. Under AJCC 8th edition criteria, thyroid cartilage invasion is a hallmark of advanced T-stage in laryngopharyngeal cancer. To examine whether invasion descriptions in reports could implicitly encode T-stage, we analyzed thyroid cartilage-related descriptions across the 439 FUZH reports (Table IX ). Of 147 reports with positive invasion descriptions, 45 (30.6%) are from pathologically confirmed early-stage (T1–T2) patients; conversely, among 172 advanced-stage (T3–T4) patients, 70 (40.7%) lack any positive description. This is because invasion descriptions reflect CT-visible findings — an imaging observation rather than a pathological diagnosis — and CT alone cannot determine whether true cartilage invasion has occurred [ 14 , 7 , 20 ] . This substantial discordance confirms that invasion descriptions do not encode T-stage, ruling out information circularity in our framework.

blocks.en: Report Quality and Cross-Institutional Robustness. All radiology reports in our study are routine clinical documents, not research-curated texts. The 439 FUZH training reports vary in detail and phrasing across radiologists while sharing a common reporting template, and the three external test sets (CGMH, EENT, TCGA) follow their own institutional conventions. Among the three modules, AOG operates entirely on CT features and is report-independent; OCA aligns reports to organs through learned cross-attention rather than keyword matching; and REG extracts structural invasion relations from report text that are typically documented even in brief reports when clinically relevant. The stable cross-institutional performance (Table II ) is consistent with the design accommodating reporting variation in practice.
blocks.zh: 质量与跨机构强健报告. 我们的研究中所有的放射学报告都是常规的临床文件,不是研究精密的文本. 439份FUZH培训报告在细节和措辞上在放射学家之间有所不同,同时共享一个共同的报告模板,三个外部测试集(CGMH, EENT, TCGA)遵循各自的机构公约. 在三个单元中,AOG完全以CT特性运作,并且是报告独立的;OCA通过学到的交叉注意而不是关键词匹配来将报告与机关相协调;REG从报告文本中提取结构性入侵关系,这些文本通常甚至在临床相关时在简短报告中得到记录。 稳定的跨机构业绩(表二)与适应实际报告差异的设计是一致的。

blocks.en: A controlled report-detail perturbation experiment (Fig. 5 (b)) provides direct support for this: keeping the same images and the frozen model while rewriting each report to be less- or more-detailed changes macro-F1 by at most 1.7 points and accuracy by at most 1.2 points.
blocks.zh: 控制下的报告-细节扰动实验(图5 (b))对此提供了直接支持:保持相同的图像和被冻结的模型,同时将每份报告重写为最小或更详细的变化宏-F1,最多1.7分,准确度最高1.2分.

blocks.en: Clinical Deployment Considerations. Several practical challenges should be considered for clinical deployment. First, the framework depends on a pre-trained organ segmentation model, whose performance may vary across imaging protocols and scanner vendors; validating or fine-tuning the segmentation model on site-specific data is advisable before deployment. Second, differences in reporting terminology and detail across institutions may affect the OCA and REG modules, though our cross-institutional evaluation suggests the learned cross-attention mechanism accommodates such variation reasonably well. Third, prospective validation on independent cohorts with different disease distributions is essential before integration into clinical decision-support workflows.
blocks.zh: 临床部署考虑。 临床部署应考虑若干实际挑战。 首先,框架依赖于一个经过预先训练的器官分解模型,其性能可能因成像协议和扫描仪供应商而异;在部署之前最好在具体地点的数据上验证或微调分解模型。 第二,各机构在报告术语和细节方面的差异可能会影响到业务协调办公室和区域办事处的模块,尽管我们的跨机构评价表明,所学到的交叉关注机制能够很好地适应这种差异。 第三,在纳入临床决策支持工作流程之前,必须对疾病分布不同的独立群体进行预期验证。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced an anatomy-structured multimodal framework for laryngopharyngeal cancer T-staging that integrates CT volumes and paired radiology reports. By explicitly modeling anatomical topology through the Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph (AOG), performing organ-level cross-modal alignment via the Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment (OCA) module, and incorporating structured clinical invasion knowledge using the Report-Enhanced Graph-Refinement (REG) module, our method effectively captures organ-specific invasion patterns and their textual evidence. Extensive experiments on the largest curated laryngopharyngeal cancer T-staging dataset, as well as on public benchmarks, demonstrated that our proposed framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art unimodal and multimodal baselines in both binary and multi-class staging tasks, achieving notable gains over radiologist assessments. Beyond performance, our framework offers improved interpretability by aligning decision-making with clinically meaningful invasion pathways, thereby enhancing its potential for real-world adoption.
Future work will explore extending the proposed topology-aware design to other head-and-neck and thoracic malignancies, as well as integrating longitudinal imaging and follow-up reports to enable dynamic tumor progression modeling.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们引入了解剖学-结构化多模式框架来治疗喉癌T-staging,将CT卷和配对的放射学报告结合起来. 通过通过解剖学-结构化器官图(AOG)明确模拟解剖地形学,通过器官-结构相通(OCA)模块进行器官层面的跨模式对接,并使用报告-强化图(REG)模块纳入结构化的临床入侵知识,我们的方法有效地抓住了器官特定入侵模式及其文字证据。 对最大的长喉癌T- stageing数据集以及公共基准的广泛试验表明,我们拟议的框架在二进制和多级中转任务中一贯优于最先进的单式和多式基线,比放射学家评估取得了显著成果。 除了业绩之外,我们的框架通过使决策与临床上有意义的入侵路径相协调,从而增强其在现实世界中采用的可能性,从而提供了更好的解释性。
今后的工作将探索将拟议的地貌意识设计扩大到其他头颈和胸腺恶性肿瘤,并整合纵向成像和后续报告,以促成动态肿瘤发展模型。
